title: AStarGrid2D.get_id_path() changed in 4.6 beta3 to not return results if start point is solid
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.6 beta3 standard
- Not reproducible in 4.5 mono, 4.6 beta1 standard, or 4.6 beta2 standard

### System information

Godot v4.6.beta3 - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Fri, 02 Jan 2026 17:52:55 +0000 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti (nvidia; 590.48.01) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-11700 @ 2.50GHz (16 threads) - 15.28 GiB memory

### Issue description

When calling `AStarGrid2D.get_id_path()` against a path where the `from_id` is marked as solid it will no longer return a path array.

This is different from the behaviour that appears to be present from 4.5 through 4.6 beta2 with no indication in the beta3 release notes that a relevant area has been modified.

### Steps to reproduce

- create a `TileMapLayer`
- add an `AStarGrid2D` and set region to tilemap `get_used_rect()`
- mark a tile as solid - `set_point_solid(Vector2i(0,0))`
- call `get_id_path(solid_tile, other_valid_tile)`
- resulting array will be empty
- in 4.6-beta2 and earlier it return a path array to the target 

Attached MRP on run will print the results to the Output log of getting a path from `(0,0) -> (1,0)`.
- 4.6 beta3 will output `[]`
- 4.6 beta2 and prior will output `[(0, 0), (1, 0)]`

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[astar-nav-46-beta-3.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24485681/astar-nav-46-beta-3.zip)
